page.layout: One printed page. Top: a paragraph of running text at full width. Then a centred title in large capitals (four lines), then a subtitle line in italic. Below: a diagram-like table of numerals in two columns (left column of numbers with labels, right column of fractions and numbers), with labels "Deunx uel Dextans", "Decunx" and a row "H 3" below. No page number, no running head.

main_text.p: Gradus integros latini eruditiores asses etiam appellant, & in duodecim partes diuidunt, easq; (sexaginta scrupulis primis uelut toto asse in duodecim partes distinctis) nominibus partium Asis exprimunt.
main_text.head: TABELLA CONTINENS NOTAS SEV CHARACTERES QVIBVS GRADVUM PARTES EXPRIMUNTUR.

page.notes: The right-hand column of fractions is read as printed; the last entries ("4 / 5", "4 / 6") and the "H 3" row are partly illegible in the scan and are uncertain. The printed footer URL (http://rcin.org.pl) is a digitiser's mark and is omitted. Long s is rendered as s; the title letters "Q" with tail in "QVIBVS" are read as printed.
